- `allow`: exact registered, declared, active and distributed tools execute immediately
- `deny`: all malformed, unknown, inactive, undistributed or unauthorized attempts fail closed

- `active_low_read_only`: `allow`, risk `low`, write `False`, reason `tool_policy_allowed`

- `active_high_read_only`: `allow`, risk `high`, write `False`, reason `tool_policy_allowed`
- `active_low_write_capable`: `allow`, risk `low`, write `True`, reason `tool_policy_allowed`
- `disabled_registry`: `deny`, risk `low`, write `False`, reason `tool_not_active`
- `disabled_tenant_policy`: `deny`, risk `low`, write `False`, reason `tool_not_active`
